range_convention: All [start,stop), source_raw absolute frame, exported_episode zero-based local frame, dataset_global real start index. Every original selected source frame remains in exactly one group.
method: All selected raw NPZ action/post_bowl_pos/done read; no RGB decode or new policy/simulation calls. Prior paired-camera timeline review and curation notes used for interpretation. Conservative carry candidates are proposed sampling-start strata, never deleted frames or joined clips.

candidate_rule.definition: After first sustained close and bowl raised above original table bowl-center z+4cm for 5 frames, protect 20 more frames; tentative carry ends at first sustained entry within 6cm XY of final stable bowl location. Exclude every actual gripper transition +/-30 frames from candidates. If lift/near cannot be found, no carry candidate. Initial already-closed clips near plate are not assumed to be grasp recovery.
candidate_rule.final_target: mean post_bowl_pos XY of last 10 source frames; offline event reference only, not deployment privileged state

risks: Phase boundaries are conservative heuristics and not exhaustive expert phase annotations.
contact_and_other is the complement, not a claim every frame is fine contact or recovery.
Some low-clearance carry is deliberately left in contact_and_other because no 4cm height event.
The 6cm final-target distance is offline only and must not enter model observation or online controls.
Sampling whole windows at a start still includes next 9 actions; preserving originals avoids discontinuities. Gripper +/-30 protection exceeds horizon10.
Known human_1792321044770146509 [478,510) late closed contact/downward press remains contact_and_other for a single-variable sampling contrast, not endorsed ideal fast release.
Late successful retreat/holds remain preserved even if inefficient; no automatic terminal-gate trimming.
No data, training configuration, GUI, model or original recordings changed.
